frames.observation: Weapon page explicitly reads MINDBENDER'S AMBITION; long dark barrel, bone fore-end, stock and hooked grip.
Post-shot low ready; weapon starts on the right with the bone fore-end and glowing Hive script visible.
Support hand opens and receiver lifts/cants away from firing pose; ammunition counter remains zero.
Gun establishes muzzle-up held cant; hand moves away below/left of receiver.
Held bone fore-end remains raised; support hand is mostly below frame, not a second HIP lift.
A red/brass cartridge is partly visible in the rising support hand below the receiver; HUD still zero.
First visible ammo credit: HUD one; raised receiver continues through hand pass.
Support forearm returns under receiver while gun maintains substantially the same held orientation.
Camera begins turning; held barrel remains raised while support hand withdraws. Camera motion is separate.
A second support-hand approach occurs below receiver during camera turn; HUD still one.
HUD two; gun remains raised as the support hand leaves, before transition toward firing orientation.
Weapon is already aiming down iron sights; authored HIP return is a neutral endpoint, not a copied ADS action.
